entries.zh: 生在鼻孔里的肉块，指鼻息肉
entries.en: that which grows in the nostrils; nasal polyp
a blister or pustule bred by the itch (scabies); scabies blister

entries.zh: 气郁结而生的瘤块；气瘤
entries.en: a lump or swelling attributed to stagnant qi (pent-up anger); qi tumour
entries.notes: 汉字栏作「氣瘤」，次字有「瘴／瘀」异读；官话栏残缺，按「瘤」字与西语『生于祸事』取气郁成瘤之义。

entries.en: conjugal affection; mutual love between husband and wife
entries.notes: 西语栏与第3条同为『nacidos en el percance』，与汉字栏不对应；据汉字「恩愛」与闽南语栏定夫妻情爱之义，官话栏残缺。

entries.en: to be born into the world; to come into the world
living creatures; things begotten or born
entries.notes: 闽南语栏夹有西语旁注『las cosas nacir』；以汉字「生物」与西语词头为准取活物之义，官话栏残缺。

entries.en: nothing at all; to have nothing whatsoever
to swim; to float in the water
to float (on the water); to drift
to overflow; (of water) to splash or spill over
entries.notes: 声调号污损难辨（T99），闽南语栏夹西语『salta el agua』且汉字有「泛」异读；按「汎」定水漫溢之义，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 游泳，如鱼般在水中游动
entries.en: to swim; to move about in the water like a fish

entries.notes: 西语栏仅残存『…Nada』，汉字栏空缺，仅余闽南语栏三音节；材料不足，无法定释义。

entries.zh: 通事，译员；居间传话的掮客
entries.notes: 西语词头「Naguatador」非通行西语（马尼拉用语，疑与纳瓦特语 nahuatlato『译员』同源）；释义据汉字「通事」与闽南语栏定为译员，官话栏残缺。

entries.zh: 臀上的肥肉，臀部多肉处
entries.en: the fleshy, fat part of the buttocks
entries.notes: 汉字栏第三字有「肶／胚」异读；按闽南语栏音写与西语 nalgas 取「肥」字义，指臀部肥肉，官话栏残缺。
